name: The Blade Courtyard
prompt: Set a wind turbine maintenance yard beneath two working rotors. A detached blade lies on padded trestles while painters apply its coloured tip beside the turning machines.

name: The Rooftop Wind Choir
prompt: Group small vertical-axis turbines on stepped roofs. Their drive belts turn visible shafts to a communal workshop where a potter and a sawyer share the wind.

name: The Weather Vane School
prompt: Install a row of small test turbines with distinct tail vanes. Technicians yaw one rotor into the breeze while students compare ribbons streaming from the others.

name: The Windmill Battery
prompt: Show a compact wind farm charging a bank of lifted weights. The turbines wind cables over high pulleys as one descending weight powers a public water pump.

name: The Folding Rotor
prompt: Lay out a turbine yard in mid-maintenance. One tower has folded down on its hinge for a blade change while two upright neighbours turn above a sheltered control gallery.
